snippet.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall  - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for Snowfall: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373090/Yes_Your_Grace_Snowfall/

A huge thank you to Percival Schuttenbach for supplying music for the trailer: https://www.youtube.com/@UCaNwZU9pYhNqYNAJNMLU3CA 

Additional Guitar by Ryan Robinson; additional Vocals, Mixing & Arrangement by Damion Sheppard.
Audio mix: Valentin Cochet & Damion Sheppard of iGame.Audio



Game Developed & Published by Brave At Night.
#yesyourgrace
